<Picture 1>：豆包，female child, small compact build with a round doll face a head wider than her shoulders, neat short black bob, big wide round eyes, plain white loose sweater, dark rolled jeans, red tassel scarf, beige canvas sneakers, softly stunned blank expression.
<Picture 2>：肥鱼，female juvenile whale-girl, small chibi build, gradient long wavy blue hair with ahoge and blue bows, whale ears and small whale tail, big round sapphire eyes, navy long-sleeve maid dress, white frilled apron, white socks, black Mary Jane shoes.
<Picture 3>：肉包子，pale steamed bun with twisted pleats at the crown, cool to the touch and faintly glossy, a bitten gap showing grey-brown meat filling and a thin skin crease where the dough was pinched.
<Picture 4>：竹筷，pair of slim bamboo chopsticks, honey-toned and lightly worn, squared tops tapering to fine tips, tips smudged with rice starch, one shaft bearing a faint scorched ring.
<Picture 5>：教堂后院台阶，A sun-warmed stone terrace behind a small parish church, wide shallow steps descending to clipped lawn, warm honey afternoon light raking low from the left with soft-edged shadows pooling at the step risers, thick-paint cel-shaded rendering with visible brush facets and crisp contour rims; a squat bell tower with arched louvres forms the main readable shape, a chestnut tree no taller than the tower's second window fixes the scale, gravel and grass underfoot, ivy on the wall behind, a low bench along the parapet, tiled rooftops and cypress hillside in the far distance.

detailed_description:
This shot runs 15 seconds. <Picture 1> sits cross-legged on the lawn a few paces off, <Picture 3> pinched in her fingers with one bite missing, and stops mid-chew, staring away at a butterfly; a clear thread of drool slips from her lip and lands on the red tassel scarf; <Picture 2> holds the step at the right edge with <Picture 4> in one hand; warm front-side light reaches both faces from the left, long soft shadows thrown across the grass toward the stone, amber on the bun crust, thick-paint cel-shaded rendering; drowsy and comic, the afternoon gone slack.

[Shot 1] A medium two-shot frames them across the terrace, <Picture 1> in the left foreground facing three-quarters away toward the butterfly, <Picture 2> in the right mid-ground turned toward her, the chestnut tree holding the scale of the tower behind.

[Shot 2] the shot transitions to a close-up on <Picture 1>'s face, jaw slack, eyes tracking something off frame, the drool thread lengthening and swinging once with her breath, dust motes sliding through the light in front of her nose.

[Shot 3] the camera cuts to <Picture 4> crossing into frame to prod <Picture 1>'s shoulder twice, <Picture 2>'s sleeve bunching at the wrist as she leans over, and <Picture 2> says, eyes still on the bowl: <d>[Chinese]豆包，你又发呆了。口水。</d>

[Shot 4] the shot changes to <Picture 1>'s profile still locked on nothing, both prods landing without a flicker, one cheek bulging around the half-chewed bite, the butterfly lifting away over the lawn and out of the top of frame.

overall_soundscape:
Bees and distant bells across the lawn as the base, matched with the small wet chew of <Picture 1>'s bite and the light tap of <Picture 4> on cloth, realistic texture, direction clear, level below dialogue.
